# Thu Le

> Personal website of Thu Le, a product designer based in Saigon, Vietnam.

Thu Le is a product designer who leads product design at a B2B SaaS startup in the private markets space.

This is her personal website where she shares writing on intentional living, productivity, tools, and everyday life.

## Main sections

- [About](https://thu-le.com/about): About Thu, a brief history, how to connect, and site colophon
- [Blog](https://thu-le.com/blog/): Personal essays and reflections
- [Now](https://thu-le.com/now/): What she's currently focused on
- [Uses](https://thu-le.com/uses): Tools and software she uses
- [Links](https://thu-le.com/links): Running notes on what she's reading, watching, and thinking about
- [Blogroll](https://thu-le.com/blogroll): Blogs and sites she follows and recommends
- [Changelog](https://thu-le.com/changelog): Notable design, content, and infrastructure changes to the site since 2020

## Notable posts

A curated list, ordered by how directly each post answers who Thu is.

- [Personal manifesto](https://thu-le.com/blog/personal-manifesto): Her operating principles for how she thinks, relates, and works
- [Good work](https://thu-le.com/blog/good-work): Her journey into design and the search for good work
- [On duality](https://thu-le.com/blog/on-duality): On holding competing wants and two identities without needing to reconcile them
- [For now](https://thu-le.com/blog/for-now): On how often "I told myself I'd never" turns out to be a snapshot, not a fact
- [I love traveling and I'm quite boring about it](https://thu-le.com/blog/i-love-traveling-and-im-quite-boring-about-it): How she stays herself on the road, and why the airport lounge is the best part
- [Learning to see, again](https://thu-le.com/blog/learning-to-see-again): Selling her camera gear in 2019, buying a pocket camera in 2026, and what changed in the seconds before a shot
- [50 things I learned in 2025](https://thu-le.com/blog/50-things-i-learned-in-2025): Annual learnings roundup

Full archive at https://thu-le.com/blog/
